frame_note: The coordinate system is centered on the ground between the two posts (x=0, y=0, z=0).
prop: deck safety railing section with two posts, a top handrail, a mid rail and a kick plate
size: about 2 m long and 1.1 m high

critiques.overall: The kitbash captures the overall structure, but several parts are misaligned or incorrectly oriented. The diagonal braces need to be tilted to form the V-shape, the post housings are hidden inside the posts and need to be moved to the outside, and the top handrail should be spun to sit horizontally.

adjust.why: Move the left housing to the outside face of the post.
Move the right housing to the outside face of the post and align its height with the left one.
Tilt the left diagonal brace so it connects the mid rail center to the bottom corner.
Tilt the right diagonal brace so it connects the mid rail center to the bottom corner.
Spin the top handrail so the dual pipes are side-by-side rather than stacked vertically.
Move the left base plate up to close the gap and meet the bottom of the post.
Move the right base plate up to close the gap and meet the bottom of the post.
The concept does not have a bracket in the center of the bottom rail.

critiques.overall: The reconstruction is mostly accurate, but has a few misplaced and misoriented parts. The post housings need to be moved to the front of the posts, the top handrail and bottom kick plate need to be spun to their correct orientations, and the left diagonal brace needs to be tilted to place its bracket at the top center.

adjust.why: Move left post housing to the front face of the left post.
Move right post housing to the front face of the right post.
Spin top handrail so the dual pipes are side-by-side horizontally.
Spin bottom kick plate rail so its wide flat face is vertical.
Tilt left diagonal brace to place its bracket at the top center.

notes: handrail ends must turn down onto the posts
braces meet at the top centre bracket, not at the bottom
